results.title: The HSV is back! - The long-awaited return to the Bundesliga
results.original_title: Der HSV ist wieder da! - Die ersehnte Rückkehr in die Bundesliga
results.overview: The HSV has achieved promotion to the Bundesliga at its seventh attempt. Hamburg fans are frenetically celebrating the return of coach Merlin Polzin's team. This marks the end of the club's ordeal in the 2. Bundesliga. After being dramatically thwarted at times just moments before reaching their desired goal, the team kept a cool head this time and sent the Hanseatic city into ecstasies with their 6-1 victory at the Volksparkstadion against SSV Ulm. The women's team of Hamburger SV also achieved promotion to the Bundesliga just one day after the men's team – the perfect setting for a boisterous celebration at Hamburg's Rathausmarkt.

results.title: 31 Candles
results.overview: Leo, a 30-year-old New Yorker who is having a Bar Mitzvah after meeting Eva, his longtime summer camp crush. In order to finish his mitzvah assignment and perhaps mature, he has to deal with, ex-partners, family members, and more.

results.title: Shaman
results.overview: An old shaman asks the spirits to let him go. He has spent his entire life serving people who demanded that their wishes be fulfilled - sometimes stupid, insignificant and causing harm to others.

results.title: Aparna Nancherla: Hopeful Potato
results.overview: Aparna Nancherla talks about social anxiety, relationship dynamics, and the benefits of aging.

results.title: The Wallet
results.overview: A man finds a lost wallet and decides to keep it. But strange events begin to unfold - the wallet isn’t just an object, it seems to draw misfortune and mystery. As reality starts to blur, he’s forced to return it, only to realize that some things are never truly lost.  Official Selection at the "Immagina Florence Film Festival" (2025) and Best Narrative Short at the "Chicago Filmmakers Award" (2025).

results.title: Sugar Rot
results.overview: After a brutal assault by an ice cream man, punk girl Candy becomes host to a mutant baby. As her body transforms into ice cream, those around her see her not as a person, but as something to be consumed.

results.title: Frieda's Case
results.overview: Chronicles the fate of Frieda Keller, a young seamstress in St. Gallen who, in 1904, is accused of murdering her 5-year-old son Ernstli.

results.title: Sarkozy-Gaddafi: The Scandal of All Scandals
results.overview: A democracy and a dictatorship. A presidential campaign and dirty money. War and death. When Nicolas Sarkozy affirmed in the press that “No one can make sense of it”, he was trying to discredit the investigation into his ties with Muammar Gaddafi, portraying it as a bunch of gibberish. As Sarkozy and his many accomplices go on trial in the Libyan campaign financing affair, here’s the film that will finally explain all of the ins and outs of one of the most remarkable French political scandals in decades.

results.title: Finding Yiyi
results.overview: After losing her mother’s cherished dumpling recipe, 65-year-old YiYi embarks on a journey to piece it back together, leading her to reconnect with a childhood friend and explore the relationship they never had.

results.title: Draft Paper
results.overview: An unfulfilled fashion designer faces the moral implications of creating his art when given an intriguing new opportunity during World War II.

results.title: Housekeepers
results.overview: Irina's childhood comes to a premature end after her non-English mother is fired from her job as a motel cleaner, upending their parent-child relationship.

results.title: Trippen
results.overview: Robert and Max need their friend Jan in order to function in life. But after having his life's work ruined during a disastrous book release, Jan has now fallen into a deep depression and can't help anyone anymore. Robert and Max now need to travel across the country to find a way to retrieve Jan's book and his will to live.

results.title: Saint Anthony
results.overview: During the journey to his family's holiday dinner, Anthony is unexpectedly forced to relocate to bizarre new accomodations.

results.title: Goranka's Time
results.overview: Portrayal of intimate life of a renown Serbian photographer Goranka Matić.
